classes.label: Class B common stock
classes.pricedAsReason: Class B is unlisted and converts one-for-one into Class A (2026 proxy: each share of Class B common stock 'is convertible at any time, at the option of the holder thereof, into one share of Class A common stock'); all classes have identical dividend and liquidation rights.

classes.label: Class F common stock
classes.pricedAsReason: Class F is unlisted and held in the Founder Voting Trust; each share converts into one share of Class B (FY2025 10-K: 'each share of Class F common stock is convertible at any time, at the option of the holder thereof, into one share of Class B common stock'), which converts one-for-one into Class A; all classes have identical dividend and liquidation rights.

notes: Class A trades on Nasdaq as PLTR; the FY2025 10-K says 'Our Class B common stock and Class F common stock are not listed on any stock exchange nor traded on any public market.' Class F is included because it shares the same dividend and liquidation rights as the other classes (it is not a nominal voting share). Counts are from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (filed November 3, 2026).
